rules.statement: The court will not grant an injunction to prevent the sale of property if the plaintiff has failed to show that irremediable mischief would result from allowing the sale, and that such damage is highly probable.
rules.supporting_quote: "The first point on which the applicant has to satisfy the Court is that irremediable mischief -will be the necessary, or at all events the highly probable, result of the sale being allowed to proceed."
